title: Kissed Crisp Russian Lamb Salad
description: A citrusy, crispy meal‑prep salad featuring tender lamb mince, kombu‑cold extract, and fresh vegetables for a low‑calorie Russian-inspired lunch.
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and brown the lamb mince for 5‑6 minutes, stirring until cooked through.
Transfer the lamb to a bowl and let it cool to room temperature.
While the lamb cools, chop cucumber, carrot, and red onion into bite‑sized pieces.
In a small bowl, whisk together kombu extract, lemon juice, olive oil, Greek yogurt, dill, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
Toss the mixed greens with the dressing until evenly coated.
Add the cooled lamb, chopped vegetables, and roasted almonds to the greens and gently mix.
Divide the salad into 4 meal‑prep containers and refrigerate.
Serve chilled or at room temperature as a low‑calorie crisp Russian lamb salad.
